findings.summary: Rejected lazy asset load promises prevented retry and left loading UI visible.
findings.correction: Evict only the failing cache entry, ignore stale selection errors, preserve the active scene and expose retry guidance. Initial failure offers a reload button.
evidence: Failed first 1906 request left playing 6033 visible; retry issued request 2 and selected 1906.
Delayed older 1906 failure did not replace newer successful 1777 selection or loading UI.
Initial 6033 failure displayed an enabled retry button; reload issued request 2, cleared the error and enabled all five exercises.
No page errors in targeted Chromium/Metal scenarios.

checks_performed: Syntax checks for all 14 JavaScript/module files and AST parse for two Python files.
In-memory bundle of current runtime exercised in actual Chromium/Metal.
Per-asset mixer/material state, DQ shader/CPU probing, morph ordering, build inputs, verification assertions and pinned model resource checks inspected.

simpler_equivalent_solution.assessment: No justified material simplification found. Shared builders/verifiers remove duplication; the confined DQ renderer and CPU probe preserve distinct rendering and validation contracts. Retry correction reuses existing cache and selection state.

limits: Per-asset media shape, evolving camera metadata, final model exports and final source-bound offline/inline checks require their separate receipts.
Native GPU transform-feedback numerical parity was not performed.
Physical-device and production application integration were not tested.
